title: The World
content:
The World
Take a stroll around the globe with our world quizzes. They're packed with trivia about capitals, landmarks, historical figures and more.
Learn More
If you consider yourself to be a huge "Friends" fan, then this is the quiz for you! Test your knowledge of the show by seeing if you can remember all these obscure little details from the series!
By Katherine G.
How well do you remember all the details about Lorelai from Gilmore Girl's seven-season run? Take our quiz on all things Lorelai to test your knowledge and find out.
By Olivia Di Pede
It is no secret that Chandler is the character that many fans related to the most, and Matthew Perry played the character to absolute perfection. Now is the time to prove your love of Chandler Bing with this ultimate Chandler quiz! Test your memory of the show and the character with these Chandler Bing questions!
By Telisa Carter
Advertisement
Grabbing an audience's attention with a few words on a poster is an art! Sometimes, a great slogan can make more of an impact than the film itself. We challenge you to name these movies based on their taglines.
By William J. Wright
Many NBA stars keep barbers across the country so they can maintain fresh haircuts throughout the season. In this quiz, those stars get a whole new look, and they didn't have to stop by the barber to get it. See if you can still identify them!
By Gavin Thagard
Wholesome, gorgeous and totally in control of her home, the '50s housewife defined an era! Once you take this quiz, you'll know exactly how much you share with some of the busiest women in history. Is it higher than you think?
By Teresa McGlothlin
A mind-boggling number of parts go into every vehicle to make it run. Toyota estimates that number somewhere along the lines of 30,000, but that includes the nuts and bolts. How many of those parts do you feel comfortable being able to identify? We promise, no "where does this bolt go?" questions!
By Nikki Weed
Advertisement
Ready to level up in life? Take a hard look in the mirror during this quiz, and you'll learn what you can do to up your game. Will you need a huge change, or will a few small steps do? Get brutally honest with yourself, and find out!
By Teresa McGlothlin
Have you been rotating your tires on time or changing your oil enough? Roll up your sleeves and get ready to wrench your way through this fun car maintenance quiz and find how much of a shade tree mechanic you are! Who knows, you might adopt a new car care regimen when you find out!
By Nikki Weed
Whether or not you get these questions right, "old man river keeps rolling along!" Do you know as much as you think you do about the world's biggest rivers? Put your knowledge to the test and see how well you do!
By Teresa McGlothlin
Whether your weakness is homophones and synonyms, confusing consonants and stressful sibilants or simply repeated typing errors, this quiz will teach you all the tricks you need to spell like a champion!
By Ashley Linkletter
Advertisement
Whether you were once a Canadian maple syrup connoisseur or the Swedish owner of the Ice Hotel, this nationality quiz will determine how you said "Zdrasti" in a foreign country!
By Talin Vartanian
Where do you park your car? Is it a "g'rah-ge" or is it a "gare-ah-ge?" Pick the words and phrases you use every day during this quiz, and we'll know if you live in the North or the South. Will we get it right?
By Teresa McGlothlin
Whether it's a heraldic shield, a fearsome animal, a simple initial or some aerodynamic wings, a logo can tell you a lot about a car company. Can you tell your Chevy bow ties from your Lamborghini bulls? Take the quiz and find out!
By Ian Fortey
Is it for real or a fraud? Dive into history with these popular stories and myths. Do you know which is a contender and which is a pretender? Test your recall with this "fact vs. fiction" quiz!
By Beth Hendricks
Advertisement
With powerful women like Black Widow and Captain Marvel, dark ones like Nebula and Hela, and mysterious ladies like the Scarlet Witch and Ghost, there are plenty of women in the MCU, but who's going to be into you? Take the quiz and see!
By Ian Fortey
You might know what Willis was talkin' about, but do you remember what his full name was? And Joanie may have loved Chachi, but what was on their IDs? If you know your '70s characters' full names, take the quiz and prove it!
By Ian Fortey
You don't need to attend Las Encinas in order to feel "Elite," because in this quiz, we're going to match your personality to one of the characters from the show! So let's find out if you're as cool as Carla or as nice as Nadia!
By Talin Vartanian
Choosing a game isn't a walk in a "Minecraft" park. That's why we're here to delve into your video game skills to find out which one you'll be the "God of War"at! So take our quiz for some more "Spore" fun!
By Talin Vartanian
Advertisement
Oops! ...We did it again. This is just so typically us. We created a quiz to honor the Princess of Pop! How well do you know Britney Spears' songs? Get "In the Zone" and take our quiz to see if you can finish these Britney Spears lyrics!
By Alex Wittman
There is no band on Earth more famous than the Beatles. The Fab Four sold more records than any other artist and recorded more No. 1 hits than anybody else in music. Can you name these classic Beatles songs from just one line?
By Jonnathan Chadwick
If you remember all of Dr. Cox's nicknames for J.D., all of the Janitor's quirky lies and all of J.D.'s weird daydreams, you just might be the ultimate "Scrubs" fan. Take a trip to Sacred Heart and see just how much of a fan you really are!
By Ian Fortey
The '70s and '80s were filled with some of the best television Americans have ever seen. Records were set, and records were broken. What do you know about the decades? Can you name these shows from the '70s and '80s?
By Jonnathan Chadwick
Advertisement
You are you! Does that make you more like Kate, Kevin or Randall, though? You might think you know which "This Is Us" family member you're most like, but do you really? Quiz through these questions, and find out!
By Teresa McGlothlin
Maybe you think that "Platypuses are the only mammals to lay eggs" like Ferb. Or perhaps your catchphrase is "How serendipitous" like Phineas. Whatever your personality is like, it's time to match you to a character from the "Phineas and Ferb"!
By Talin Vartanian
